Plot paired module heatmaps across cell groups

Source: R/plot_module.R
plot_module_heatmap.Rd

This function builds paired module-level heatmaps showing smoothed rhythmic expression patterns along inferred cell phase. For each selected module, genes are ordered by module-specific reference phase and expression is smoothed separately in two specified cell groups.

Usage

plot_module_heatmap(
  count,
  res_phase,
  gene_meta,
  metadata,
  group_by,
  group1,
  group2,
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  module_ids = 0:7,
  phase_levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22),
  scale_factor = 10000,
  palette = NULL,
  Verbose = FALSE,
  compare_groups = NULL
)

Arguments

count

A gene-by-cell count matrix. Row names must be gene names and column names must be cell names.

res_phase

A data.frame returned by infer_cell_phase(). It must contain "cell" and the column specified by theta_by.

gene_meta

A data.frame returned by infer_rhythm_module(). It must contain "gene" and "module_map" columns, as well as group-specific rhythm parameter columns such as "Phase_A", "Amplitude_A", and "FDR_A". The alternative column style "phi_A", "A_A", and "q_A" is also supported.

metadata

A data.frame containing cell-level metadata. Cells are matched to count by the cell column if available, otherwise by rownames.

group_by

A character vector specifying the column name in metadata used to define the two paired cell groups.

group1

A character vector specifying the first (left) group to plot. This controls display order, not the inference comparison direction.

group2

A character vector specifying the second (right) group to plot. This controls display order, not the inference comparison direction.

theta_by

A character vector specifying the column name in res_phase containing inferred cell phase in radians. Defaults to "theta_pred".

module_ids

An integer vector specifying modules to plot. Defaults to 0:7.

phase_levels

A numeric vector specifying displayed phase groups in hours. Defaults to c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22).

scale_factor

A numeric value passed to Seurat::NormalizeData(). Defaults to 10000.

palette

A named list specifying optional palettes for phase, group, and heatmap. If NULL, black/white phase labels, default scRhythmBayes group colors, and a blue-red heatmap palette are used. Defaults to NULL.

Verbose

Logical; if TRUE, progress messages are printed.

compare_groups

Optional character vector c(group1, group2) specifying the original infer_rhythm_module() comparison direction. Inferred from gene_meta$group1/group2 when available; required for M2-M7 in legacy results lacking these columns. M2/M4 use comparison group2 and the other modules use comparison group1 for row ordering, regardless of display order. This selects the gained/stronger side for gain or amplitude changes. Default group colors follow comparison identities, not left/right position. Phase annotations label four-hour intervals by their left endpoints. Missing reference phases are retained last with a warning. Nonzero modules with no finite reference phase produce an error rather than an unsorted plot.

Value

An object of class scRhythmModuleHeatmap. Each successful module includes a phase_order table; summary$n_phase_ordered and summary$n_phase_missing count reference phases before smoothing.

Details

This function accepts a gene-by-cell count matrix and uses Seurat internally for log-normalization and scaling. Users do not need to provide a Seurat object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

cell_use <- as.character(srb_example_data$meta$celltype) == "1"

res_param <- infer_gene_param(
  count = srb_example_data$Count[, cell_use, drop = FALSE],
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta[cell_use, , drop = FALSE],
  theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred[cell_use],
  r_cell = res_phase$r_cell[cell_use],
  strata_by = "condition",
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  B = 5,
  n_worker = 1,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

res_module <- infer_rhythm_module(
  param_wide = res_param$param_wide,
  compare_by = "condition",
  group1 = "A",
  group2 = "B",
  out_dir = NULL,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

hm <- plot_module_heatmap(
  count = srb_example_data$Count[, cell_use, drop = FALSE],
  res_phase = res_phase[cell_use, , drop = FALSE],
  gene_meta = res_module$module_result,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta[cell_use, , drop = FALSE],
  group_by = "condition",
  group1 = "A",
  group2 = "B"
)

hm
plot(hm, module_id = 0)
} # }
